svg.title: State
svg.desc:
A draft loops through review until it is published.
● │ │ ╭───▼───╮ ┌─▶ Draft │ │ ╰───────╯ │ │ changes │ │ submit │ │ │ ╭───▼────╮ └─│ Review │ ╰────────╯ │ approve │ │ ╭─────▼─────╮ │ Published │ ╰───────────╯ │ │ ▼ ◉
